name: Midnight Delight
source:
"It's just a quick bite right...? I shouldn't be so nervous..."

You've known V for several months now and in those months you've slowly grown closer....just close enough for him to ask you on a date!

V just seems to have this sort of magnetism to them that is unshakeable....almost supernatural...

[from [url=https://arthungrydemon.itch.io/midnight-delight]itch.io[/url]]
